Friends need an account

This copy of TravelMe runs as a plain website with no sign-in, so it has nowhere to keep a shared profile and no way to tell who you are. Your trips live in this browser only.

Open the account version of TravelMe to share trips, add friends and see where they are going. Everything else works the same in both.

Your sharing

—

Sharing is off until you choose otherwise, and hotel names stay out of what you publish unless you switch them on per trip. Anything you do share is stored in this app's shared space, so treat Friends as "people using this app", not as a lock.
